checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The includesText lists arrangements conference, notices, shelter of remains, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No additional mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears; only the basic services fee is described as non-declinable.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so it is in immediate conjunction by page placement.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so it is on the same page as the prices.
Direct cremation is offered with a fiberboard container and unfinished wood box, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions cremation but the list shows no cash-advance crematory fee, and no conflicting billing is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are all listed with prices, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line.
The list contains no optional combination package; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase; required statements that purchases are not required are not concerns.
No text claims goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required disclosures, and the disclosures use the prescribed wording.
